title: Rabbi Chanan, Father of Rabbi Shimon
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:5: “Rabbi Yoni said: I went to the South and heard Rabbi Chanan, the father of Rabbi Shimon, in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.” In Chullin 132b it reads simply “the elders of the South.” Hyman also reports the statement in the Jerusalem Talmud on Chullin then newly printed, folio 73a. The scholar R. Z. Babar (באבאר) wrote in HaKedem, part 1, p. 33, that this Amora is not found anywhere. Hyman objects that he did not see the above Jerusalem Talmud on Peah. His son Rabbi Shimon is mentioned in Midrash Tehillim 78:17.

notes.text: The supplied באבאר is retained as Babar rather than silently identified as Bacher. Hyman reports the then newly printed “Jerusalem Talmud on Chullin”; this is an attributed historical bibliographical claim, not an assertion that the work is canonical or newly published now. His criticism of the scholar remains his own.

The consulted Peah 1:5 reads Rabbi Yose rather than supplied Rabbi Yoni, and has the parenthesized name Shimon ben Levi in the reported chain; the paragraph also names Yehoshua ben Levi in a separate opening transmission. The supplied wording is retained without merging the occurrences.
